about.title: ABOUT US
about.intro_p1: Al-Hayani Company is a Syrian pharmaceutical importation, marketing, and distribution company established in 1997.
about.intro_p2: The company is officially registered with the Syrian Ministry of Health under Registration No. 3190 and with the Commercial Registry under Registration No. 13356.
about.intro_p3: For nearly three decades, Al-Hayani Company has built a strong presence in the Syrian pharmaceutical market. We operate through 13 branches across Syria, supported by an established network of distributors, retail pharmacies, physicians, and other healthcare professionals.

services.s5: Product launch, promotion, and market-development support

services.s7: Access to the Syrian healthcare market, which includes approximately 20,000 pharmacies and more than 25,000 physicians

about.partners_p: We work closely with international pharmaceutical and healthcare companies seeking a knowledgeable, dependable, and long-term commercial partner in Syria. Our local experience, regulatory knowledge, and nationwide distribution capabilities enable us to support our partners throughout every stage—from registration and importation to product launch, promotion, and nationwide distribution.
about.mission_p: Our mission is to improve access to high-quality healthcare products in Syria while building transparent, sustainable, and mutually beneficial partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers worldwide.

accreditation.title: Official Accreditation & Membership
accreditation.text: The company holds an official Membership Certificate from the Aleppo Chamber of Commerce and Industry for the year 2014, No. 1877, issued under Law No. 131 of 1959. Classified as an Individual Establishment, it has been awarded First Degree membership for engaging in wholesale drug trading, import, and export, reflecting its reputable commercial standing.

mainCenter.title: Main Distribution Center
mainCenter.text: Hayani Pharma operates its main distribution center as the strategic hub for warehousing, preparation, and supply coordination. Through this center, we manage efficient stock handling and reliable pharmaceutical distribution across the Syrian market.Our cold-chain storage and transportation capabilities meet the Syrian Ministry of Health’s licensing requirements for pharmaceutical warehouses handling temperature-sensitive products. Our facilities include temperature-controlled storage areas for large-volume storage and refrigerators for smaller quantities. Backup emergency power and cooling units help maintain the required storage conditions during power outages.Our distribution vehicles are equipped with cooling systems to maintain the required temperature range throughout transportation, supporting product quality from storage to delivery.

avenzor.name: Avenzor for Pharmaceutical Industries
avenzor.overview: A leading private Syrian pharmaceutical company established in 1991, with production starting in 1996. Its main facility is located in Rural Damascus (Saboura).
avenzor.features: Operates advanced production lines compliant with global cGMP standards, featuring an independent, dedicated facility for penicillins and antibiotics to prevent cross-contamination.
avenzor.products: Paradrin Night, Lostamin, Detrospam, eye drops, and broad-spectrum antibiotics.

medico.name: Medico Labs
medico.overview: One of the oldest and most established private pharmaceutical companies in Syria, founded in Homs in 1958. Its modern facility spans 14,000 square meters along the Homs-Damascus highway.
medico.features: Holds ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environmental), and OHSAS 18001 (Safety) certifications, featuring a specialized mono-dose line for preservative-free eye drops.
medico.products: Voltoned, Cold Free, Asprix, Ketofen, and Moxi-Drop.

alfares.name: Al-Fares Pharma
alfares.overview: A premier private Syrian pharmaceutical company established in 1991, with commercial production launching in May 1998 in Rural Damascus (Ein Menin).
alfares.features: Equipped with an advanced Research & Development (R&D) lab, holds ISO 9001 quality certification, and exports products to several regional and international markets.
alfares.products: Tablets, capsules, oral liquids and syrups, dry syrups, ointments, creams, and nutritional supplements.

himalaya.name: Himalaya Wellness Company
himalaya.overview: A global multinational herbal health and pharmaceutical company founded in India in 1930. It specializes in science-backed Ayurvedic herbal medicines, supplements, and personal care products.
himalaya.features: Combines traditional herbal wisdom with modern scientific research, distributing its products in over 100 countries with key regional hubs in Dubai, Singapore, and Houston.
himalaya.products: Liv.52 (liver care), Koflet (cough syrup), Cystone (kidney health), and Neem face cleansers.

unichima.name: Unichima Pharmaceuticals
unichima.overview: A private Syrian pharmaceutical company established in Damascus in 1997, with its main manufacturing plant located on the Damascus International Airport highway.
unichima.features: Strictly implements Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) alongside a dedicated pharmacovigilance system to monitor drug safety and side effects.
unichima.products: Opressor (cardiovascular), Danizen Forte, Demicylate 250 (hemostatic), and Tomapyrin.

ibnhayyan.name: Ibn Hayyan Pharmaceuticals
ibnhayyan.overview: Tracing its roots back to Al-Istiqama Pharmacy founded in Homs in 1908, the modern plant began operations in 1993 in Homs over a 20,000-square-meter floor space.
ibnhayyan.features: Features independent, specialized production blocks for penicillins, cephalosporins, and injectables (ampoules/vials) to completely eliminate cross-contamination risks.
ibnhayyan.products: Duspavin (colitis/spasms), Diclon Retard, Vascotroy, Lazin, and Naya C effervescent tablets.

partnerWithUs.title: Partner With Us
partnerWithUs.subtitle: Your Strategic Pharmaceutical Partner in Syria and Emerging International Markets
partnerWithUs.introTitle: A Commercial Partner Built for Growth
partnerWithUs.intro1: Hayani Pharma welcomes partnerships with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, diagnostic, consumer-health, and nutritional-product manufacturers seeking an experienced commercial partner.
partnerWithUs.intro2: Established in 1997, we provide integrated regulatory, importation, distribution, marketing, and export-development services. From regulatory assessment and registration to product launch and long-term market development, we develop partnership models tailored to each manufacturer's portfolio and commercial objectives.
partnerWithUs.opportunitiesIntro: We are interested in long-term partnerships involving:
partnerWithUs.opportunitiesClosing: We welcome established manufacturers and qualified companies offering distinctive, high-quality, and commercially promising products.

opportunities.o5: Export of Syrian and partner-manufactured products

partnerWithUs.marketIntro: International manufacturers generally must complete two regulatory stages before marketing pharmaceutical products in Syria.
partnerWithUs.manufacturerIntro: The foreign manufacturer and relevant manufacturing site must first be evaluated and registered with the Syrian Ministry of Health.
partnerWithUs.documentsMayInclude: Depending on the manufacturer, product category, and applicable regulatory pathway, the required documents may include:

manufacturerDocuments.d1: A legalized Letter of Authorization appointing Hayani Pharma as the authorized representative
manufacturerDocuments.d5: List of products manufactured and marketed
manufacturerDocuments.d6: Certificate of Pharmaceutical Product or Free Sale Certificate
manufacturerDocuments.d7: Evidence of registration or marketing in the country of origin or other recognized markets
manufacturerDocuments.d8: Information about manufacturing capabilities and quality-management systems
manufacturerDocuments.d9: Additional documents or manufacturing-site inspections when required

partnerWithUs.manufacturerSupport: Hayani Pharma assists manufacturers with document assessment, legalization requirements, submission preparation, regulatory communication, and application follow-up.
partnerWithUs.productIntro: Once the manufacturer and manufacturing site satisfy the applicable requirements, individual products may be submitted for registration.

productDocuments.p1: Common Technical Document dossier or applicable national dossier
productDocuments.p2: Certificate of Pharmaceutical Product or Free Sale Certificate
productDocuments.p3: Approved product information from the country of origin
productDocuments.p7: Stability studies supporting the proposed shelf life
productDocuments.p9: Bioequivalence or clinical documentation, when applicable
productDocuments.p11: Product samples and reference standards, when requested

partnerWithUs.productClosing: Requirements vary for conventional medicines, biological products, vaccines, medical devices, nutritional supplements, cosmetics, and other healthcare products. The applicable requirements and regulatory pathway should therefore be confirmed for each manufacturer and product before submission.

regulatory.r2: Identification of the appropriate regulatory pathway
regulatory.r7: Communication with the Syrian Ministry of Health
regulatory.r8: Responses to regulatory questions and deficiency notices
regulatory.r9: Coordination of samples, reference standards, and laboratory testing

partnerWithUs.regulatoryClosing: Registration timelines depend on the product category, dossier completeness, inspection requirements, and Ministry review. We work closely with our partners to anticipate requirements and reduce avoidable delays.
partnerWithUs.launchIntro: Following registration, Hayani Pharma can support:
partnerWithUs.launchClosing: Through 13 branches and an established national network, we reach pharmacies, physicians, hospitals, clinics, distributors, and other healthcare organizations throughout Syria.
partnerWithUs.exportIntro: In addition to supporting market entry into Syria, Hayani Pharma seeks to develop export opportunities for qualified Syrian and partner-manufactured pharmaceutical and healthcare products.
partnerWithUs.regionsTitle: We are particularly interested in emerging and high-growth markets across:

regions.region1: The Middle East and North Africa
regions.region5: Selected emerging and underserved European markets

partnerWithUs.exportServicesIntro: Depending on the product and destination, our export-development services may include:

exportServices.e2: Identification of qualified importers and distributors

partnerWithUs.exportClosing: All exports remain subject to applicable laws, product-registration requirements, trade restrictions, quality standards, and destination-country regulations. Before entering a market, we work with manufacturers and local partners to evaluate regulatory feasibility, commercial potential, and supply-chain requirements.
